assign.request: Audit what breaks when lew42.com is served static (no Server/, no socket, no /data writes, no /mcp), what is in the git tree that should not be pushed (task records, session transcripts, session.json, pngs, usage files, /data), and which .claude/ hooks/skills/MCP config would not work for a teammate on a fresh clone. Three tables + a <=10-line verdict list in audit.md, <=110 lines. Verify two rows with headless Playwright, socket blocked.
steps: grep public/ for dev-server seams, build runtime table
git status/ls-files audit for the commit table
audit .claude/ hooks, skills, .mcp.json for the other-devs table
verify two runtime-table rows with headless Playwright, socket blocked

assign.now: verified with headless Playwright (socket blocked): DevBar and AI day dashboard both render with content, zero console errors

log.msg: Socket.js has a deliberate localhost-only gate — off localhost it no-ops instead of throwing; DevBar itself is mounted unconditionally on every page (app.js calls devbar(this) with no env check), so its JS/CSS ship to every visitor even though the socket-dependent rows inside it go inert

git ls-files public/framework/ai/ = 671 tracked files, 25.4MB; 136 are pngs (18MB, ~70% of the weight), 9 are session.json, 171 task.jsonl, 2 usage.json/usage.jsonl slipped past the gitignore (only the top-level usage.json and **/shots/ are ignored, dated snapshots and 15 of the 136 pngs live under shots/ but were committed before that rule existed)

session.json is a task summary (session_id, prompt text, outcome) not a raw transcript; still served as a plain static file in production at its literal path since public/ ships as-is — a stranger can curl any committed session.json/task.jsonl and read the owner's prompts

only 12 skills under .claude/skills (brief said ~15); check-claude-usage hangs on ~/.claude/bin/claude-usage.py which is not in the repo and is PowerShell-only — broken for any teammate on any OS; figma MCP server is not in .mcp.json (only site is), so it is configured in the owner's user-level Claude Code config, not portable

assign.outcome: **Static-launch audit done** — three tables + verdicts in [audit.md](./audit.md) (54 lines): DevBar and the AI dashboard both render clean and error-free static (verified live, headless Playwright, socket blocked); the real push blockers are 671 tracked files (25.4MB, 18MB of it pngs) under `public/framework/ai/` carrying the owner's prompts and session data, served today as plain static JSON — no dev server needed to read them; and `check-claude-usage` + figma MCP are not portable to a teammate's fresh clone. Left for a follow-up: actually moving/ignoring the ai/ tree and shipping the usage script.
